headline: Aprobación de facturas, recibos, órdenes de cambio de contrato, políticas, contratos, solicitudes benéficas, y pagos de proyectos de capital.
summary: La junta revisará y aprobará el pago de facturas, recibos, cuotas, y órdenes de cambio de contrato. También cubrirá políticas y contratos, solicitudes benéficas, correspondencia, pagos de proyectos de capital, y ofertas de capacitación y conferencias.
items: Aprobación de Facturas y Firma de Cheques
Aprobación del Pago de Recibos, Cuotas, Solicitudes de Pago y Órdenes de Cambio de Contrato
Revisión de Recibos de Proyectos de Capital Aprobados para Pago, Requisiciones de Pago, y toda otra Documentación de Proyecto Aplicable
Revisión de Ofertas de Capacitación y Conferencias Aprobadas
review: headline: "invoices" is translated as "recibos" (receipts), which is a different document. The correct word is "facturas", but "bills" is already translated as "facturas", so one of the two terms is mistranslated. The English also lists "bills, invoices", which the Spanish presents as "facturas, recibos".; summary: "invoices" is translated as "recibos" (receipts), which changes the meaning.; items 2: "Invoices" is translated as "Recibos" (receipts), which changes the meaning; it should be "Facturas".; items 6: "Invoices" is translated as "Recibos" (receipts), which changes the meaning. Also, "Approved" is attached to "Recibos" in the Spanish, while the English "Approved for Payment" modifies the invoices, so the grouping is altered slightly.; items 7: The Spanish "Ofertas de Capacitación y Conferencias Aprobadas" makes "Aprobadas" ambiguous. The English means that the training and conference offerings were approved. Here the adjective could apply only to the conferences.
